system.name: text-visual in-context learning
system.one_liner: Language-only LLMs solve vision-language tasks by reading verbalised images (captions and labels) inside few-shot prompts.

content.variant_note: left-to-right chain: image verbalisation, a colour-coded prompt template with two task columns, then the LLM and its answer, joined by word-bearing block arrows
content.argues: A text-only LLM can do vision-and-language tasks if images are first converted into text by captioning and classification models and placed in a few-shot prompt.
content.subject: Image verbalisation by two pre-trained models, the colour-coded prompt template (task description, in-context samples, evaluation sample) and the LLM.

lessons.what_to_learn: Draw the prompt as a colour-coded stack of labelled sections with placeholders in angle brackets and show two task variants as columns; precede it with a verbalisation stage that turns one photo into quoted text, and join the stages with block arrows that carry a word.
lessons.suits: In-context learning or prompting methods where the prompt layout is the contribution and inputs of another modality are converted to text first.

evidence: Model architecture for in-context learning for vision-language tasks.
The prompt text comprises the task description, in-context sample pairs, and the input of the evaluation sample.
The language model is expected to generate a text sequence that follows the word Answer

summary: The paper asks whether language-only large language models can handle vision-language tasks when images are given as text, and compares open models against GPT-3 on five tasks. Figure 1 shows the pipeline from left to right. A yellow frame turns a sample photo into text with an image classification model and an image captioning model, giving a keyword list and a caption. A block arrow appends these to the samples of a blue Prompt Text frame, built from a grey task description, pink in-context samples and a green evaluation sample, in two columns for question answering and classification, all written with placeholders. The prompt goes to a blue LLM box, which generates the answer.
summary_zh: 论文探究只懂文字的大模型如何做视觉语言任务：先用图像分类和描述模型把图片转成文字，再拼进提示。图 1 自左向右：黄色框中示例照片得到关键词与描述，追加到蓝色提示文本（任务说明、粉色示例、绿色评测样本），交给 LLM 生成答案。
